title: Synthetic Pagila OLTP
description: Pure OLTP: short read/write transactions by key over a deterministic DVD-rental schema; pgbench-side random identifiers, prepared statements, 50/25/20/5 select/insert/update/delete mix.

benchmark.init_command: ARG_PSQL_PATH -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h ARG_PG_HOST -p ARG_PG_PORT -U ARG_PG_USER -d ARG_PG_DATABASE -f ARG_WORKLOAD_PATH/sql/pagila-schema.sql && ARG_PYTHON_PATH ARG_WORKLOAD_PATH/generator.py --scale ARG_WORKLOAD_SCALE && ARG_PSQL_PATH -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h ARG_PG_HOST -p ARG_PG_PORT -U ARG_PG_USER -d ARG_PG_DATABASE -f ARG_WORKLOAD_PATH/sql/pagila-benchmark-setup.sql
benchmark.workload_command: ARG_PGBENCH_PATH --no-vacuum --random-seed=42 -M prepared --client=ARG_PGBENCH_CLIENTS --jobs=ARG_PGBENCH_CLIENTS --time=ARG_WORKLOAD_DURATION_SECONDS --progress=10 -h ARG_PG_HOST -p ARG_PG_PORT -U ARG_PG_USER -f ARG_WORKLOAD_PATH/sql/01_select.sql@50 -f ARG_WORKLOAD_PATH/sql/02_insert.sql@25 -f ARG_WORKLOAD_PATH/sql/03_update.sql@20 -f ARG_WORKLOAD_PATH/sql/04_delete.sql@5 ARG_PG_DATABASE
